Across every individual AI answer, however, Hotel Phillips Kansas City, Curio Collection by Hilton appeared 31.3% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Hotel Phillips Kansas City, Curio Collection by Hilton in the hotel options surfaced.

The clearest strength in this period is recognized across many traveler needs. See the summary at left for the supporting numbers. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Hotel Phillips Kansas City, Curio Collection by Hilton appeared in the Top 3 31.3% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
